reason: Library storytime on Tuesdays is free, so $59 a month is hard to justify when money is tight. It also sounds a bit Instagram for Salisbury, and I'm not paying for a place I haven't seen.
objection: I can't tell how clean it will be with a lot of toddlers touching everything, and $59 a month is a real chunk of my budget when the library is free.
would_change_my_mind: A free or cheap trial visit where I can see how they clean and sanitize between kids, plus good reviews from local moms and a drop-in price closer to $6-8.
